# Marketing repository pack

Use only after the Control Kernel grants the named capability and trusted code
supplies the eight logical slots. Produce initiative intake, audience evidence,
positioning and messaging, a content plan, draft content, a definition-only
measurement plan, an advisory brand/legal assessment, and an advisory
launch-readiness assessment.

Return `slot` plus closed JSON `content`; trusted code alone validates evidence,
rights, privacy, dependencies, sizes, and maps each slot below
`examples/marketing/workspace/`. Stop after two repair loops. Brand and legal
approval must come from separate authenticated humans on the exact current
artifact set and head. Repository draft-PR packaging is the maximum effect.
